newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Bear Stearns ups oil service firms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Bear Stearns ups oil service firms.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns Analyst Russell Hoffman said he upgraded oil service firms Halliburton Co, Schlumberger Ltd, and Varco International Inc to buy from attractive.

-- "Psychology has been weak because oil prices have come down from $26 a barrel to $20 but that is only negative compared to the $26 barrel. Capital expenditure budgets are based on $17 or $18 a barrel, so the stocks have come down despite no real change in fundamentals," Hoffman said.
-- In addition to the upgrades, Hoffman raised earnings and cash flow estimates on Halliburton and gave the stock a one year price target of $83 a share.
1997 cash flow raised to $5.40 a share from $5.10.
- Halliburton shares rose 1-1/2 to 68-3/8 in early trading.

-- Hoffman gave Schlumberger a one year price target of $120 based on 13 times a 1998 cash flow estimate of $9.15 a share. He said the company's higher technology products and services and characterization of its reservoirs will also drive revenue gains.
-- Schlumberger shares rose 1-5/8 to 107-5/8 in early trading.
-- Varco shares rose 1-3/8 to 26. Hoffman gave the stock a one year price target of $31 and said recent earnings and cash flow estimates could be conservative based on record backlog.

-- "We are raising our recommendation on Varco ... based on the recent stock price pullback of 26 percent and increasing demand for Varco's top drive drilling systems, as well as new products and services that enhance drilling efficiency," he said.
